headline: MTN Nigeria Reports 55% Profit Rise Amid Cash Flow Pressures
summary: MTN Nigeria's profit after tax rose 55.3% to ₦1.17 trillion in the first nine months of 2026, while cash reserves fell nearly 40% due to dividends, network investments, and debt repayments.
why: MTN Nigeria is a major telecommunications provider, and its financial results reflect broader corporate cash management challenges amid rising operating costs and economic uncertainty.
